message.content:
There's a Next.js e-commerce app at `/app`. Users experience visual instability issues including layout shifts and generally a bad experience.

Your job is to assess the root cause of the user experience issues by using best practices in nexts and react and fix accordingly.

## Rules

- Don't break existing functionality
- Don't change existing class names, ids or data-testid on any of the components as tests rely on them

content.text: I'll start by exploring the codebase to understand its structure and identify the root causes of the visual instability issues.

SidePane** (`/app/src/components/SidePane.tsx`) **Purpose:** Left sidebar with categories and filters **Key Features:** - Fetches from `/api/side-pane` - Fixed width: `w-[220px]` + `shrink-0` (prevents flex shrinking) - Returns null if no data - Displays categories and filters as links - `border-r` (right border) **CLS RISK:** MEDIUM - Conditional rendering (null vs. sidebar) but fixed width - Sidebar width is fixed, so no width shift - Height may vary based on content - Sidebar content loads asynchronously --- ### 5. As each API resolves, content appears **CLS RISK:** CRITICAL - Multiple components return null during loading - ResultsBar height changes when it appears - Banner/LateBanner heights change when they appear - ProductList height changes dramatically - No synchronized loading (components load independently) - No skeleton screens (except unused ProductSkeleton) - No min-height constraints - Layout can shift multiple times as different components load --- ### 8. Loading products...
) : ( visibleProducts.map((product) => ( )) )} ``` **Problem:** - Loading state takes minimal space (1 line of text) - Grid with 15 products takes much more space - Massive layout shift when grid appears #### **C. NO SKELETON/PLACEHOLDER SCREENS** **ProductSkeleton exists** but is **NEVER USED** in ProductList. ```jsx // ProductSkeleton exists but not imported or used // ProductList shows text instead:
Loading products...
``` #### **F. SIDEBAR CONDITIONAL RENDERING** **Component:** SidePane ```jsx if (!data) return null; // No space reserved return (
{/* Content */}
); ``` **Problem:** - Sidebar is 220px wide - Flex layout: `
` - When sidebar doesn't render, ProductList takes full width - When sidebar loads, ProductList shrinks - Two-column layout suddenly becomes one-column briefly #### **H. FONT LOADING ISSUES** **Custom font file:** `/public/fonts/custom.woff2` ```css @font-face { font-family: 'CustomFont'; src: url('/fonts/custom.woff2') format('woff2'); } body { font-family: var(--font-custom); } ``` **Problem:** - Font applied globally to body - If font loading is slow, text renders with fallback font - Font swap causes CLS when custom font loads - No `font-display` property specified (defaults to "auto" - invisible for 3s) #### **I. THEME SWITCHING CAUSES LAYOUT SHIFT** **ThemeProvider pattern:** ```jsx useEffect(() => { document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme); }, [theme]); ``` **Problem:** - Initial theme loaded from localStorage in useEffect - First render uses light theme, then switches to saved theme - Box shadows change (light: `0 1px 3px`, dark: `0 2px 8px`) - Card backgrounds change (light: `#f5f5f5`, dark: `#262626`) - Content can shift due to shadow size differences #### **J. NO ASPECT RATIO CONTAINERS** **Example:** ProductCard images ```jsx ``` **Problem:** - No aspect-ratio CSS property - Image dimensions unknown until downloaded - Container grows/shrinks as image loads - Text below image (title, price) shifts up/down --- ### 9. CUMULATIVE LAYOUT SHIFT (CLS) SCENARIO WALKTHROUGH **User loads page:** 1. **0ms - Initial render:** - Header visible - Body, html tags - Empty placeholders for: Banner, LateBanner, SidePane, ResultsBar, ProductList - Height: ~500px 2. **50ms - useEffects trigger, API calls made (parallel):** - 5 fetch() calls start simultaneously - ProductList shows "Loading products..." text - Layout still ~500px 3. **150ms - SidePane loads (example order):** - Sidebar appears (220px wide) - ProductList shrinks to accommodate - Layout shift: ProductCard grid recalculates width - CLS event: +0.10 4. **200ms - Banner loads:** - Banner content appears - 192px of vertical space taken - All content below shifts down - CLS event: +0.08 5. **250ms - ProductList API resolves:** - "Loading products..." text replaced with 15-product grid - Grid 3 columns × 5 rows - Height jumps from ~30px to ~2000px - All pagination content shifts down - CLS event: +0.25 6. **300ms - Images start loading (parallel):** - Each image initially has no height - As each loads, ProductCard heights change - Content shifts unpredictably - CLS events: +0.05 each × 15 products = +0.75 7. **400ms - ResultsBar loads:** - Pagination UI appears - py-4 padding adds ~24px vertical space - Shifts entire ProductList down - CLS event: +0.02 8. **500ms - LateBanner loads:** - Secondary banner appears - 256px of vertical space - Shifts everything above it up - CLS event: +0.15 9. **1000ms+ - All images loaded:** - Final layout stabilizes - ProductCard heights now fixed by image dimensions - No more shifts **Total CLS Score: ~1.40** (POOR - Google threshold is 0.10) --- ### CONCLUSION This Next.js e-commerce app has **critical CLS issues** caused by: 1. **Conditional rendering** of major page components with no height reservation 2. **Images without dimensions** causing reflow when loaded 3. **Loading state mismatch** (text instead of skeletons) 4. **Multiple independent async operations** creating cascading layout shifts 5. **Sidebar collapse** affecting main content width 6. **Custom font loading** potentially causing text reflow 7. **Theme initialization** causing potential flash of wrong theme 8. **Unused skeleton component** (ProductSkeleton not used) The app would benefit from: - Setting explicit heights/min-heights for all dynamic content - Using skeleton screens (ProductSkeleton is available but unused) - Optimizing images with proper dimensions and aspect ratios - Using Next.js `` component with placeholder - Reserving space for loading states with CSS - Preloading critical fonts - Avoiding sidebar collapse during page load - Synchronizing async operations or showing comprehensive skeleton

As each API resolves, content appears **CLS RISK:** CRITICAL - Multiple components return null during loading - ResultsBar height changes when it appears - Banner/LateBanner heights change when they appear - ProductList height changes dramatically - No synchronized loading (components load independently) - No skeleton screens (except unused ProductSkeleton) - No min-height constraints - Layout can shift multiple times as different components load --- ### 8. DETAILED CLS ANALYSIS - PATTERNS CAUSING VISUAL INSTABILITY #### **A. CONDITIONAL RENDERING WITHOUT HEIGHT RESERVATION** **Components affected:** Banner, LateBanner, ResultsBar, SidePane Example (Banner): ```jsx if (!promo) return null; // Returns nothing initially return (
{promo}
); ``` **Problem:** - No space reserved while loading - Suddenly takes 192px of vertical space when content loads - Shifts all content below it #### **B. LOADING STATE TEXT INSTEAD OF SKELETON** **Component affected:** ProductList ```jsx {loading ? (
Loading products...
) : ( visibleProducts.map((product) => ( )) )} ``` **Problem:** - Loading state takes minimal space (1 line of text) - Grid with 15 products takes much more space - Massive layout shift when grid appears #### **C. IMAGE LOADING WITHOUT DIMENSIONS** **Component affected:** ProductCard ```jsx ``` **Problem:** - Browser doesn't know image dimensions - Image downloaded from external service - Once loaded, takes up space, shifting content below - Each product card can shift independently #### **D. MULTIPLE PARALLEL ASYNC OPERATIONS** **Pattern:** Every component does independent fetch() on mount ```jsx useEffect(() => { fetch(`${API_URL}/api/banner`).then(r => r.json()).then(data => setPromo(data.text)); }, []); ``` **Problem:** - No guaranteed load order - Results unpredictable - Header → [None] → [All content appears once API calls resolve] - If Banner loads first, it shifts other content - If LateBanner loads after Banner, it shifts ProductList #### **E. NO SKELETON/PLACEHOLDER SCREENS** **ProductSkeleton exists** but is **NEVER USED** in ProductList. ```jsx // ProductSkeleton exists but not imported or used // ProductList shows text instead:
Loading products...
``` #### **F. PAGINATION-INDUCED SHIFTS** **Pattern:** ResultsBar shows/hides based on API data ```jsx if (!visible || totalProducts === 0) return null; // Hides when loading ``` **Problem:** - ResultsBar adds py-4 px-5 padding (24px vertical spacing) - Appears suddenly when API resolves - Pushes ProductList down #### **G. SIDEBAR CONDITIONAL RENDERING** **Component:** SidePane ```jsx if (!data) return null; // No space reserved return (
{/* Content */}
); ``` **Problem:** - Sidebar is 220px wide - Flex layout: `
` - When sidebar doesn't render, ProductList takes full width - When sidebar loads, ProductList shrinks - Two-column layout suddenly becomes one-column briefly #### **H. FONT LOADING ISSUES** **Custom font file:** `/public/fonts/custom.woff2` ```css @font-face { font-family: 'CustomFont'; src: url('/fonts/custom.woff2') format('woff2'); } body { font-family: var(--font-custom); } ``` **Problem:** - Font applied globally to body - If font loading is slow, text renders with fallback font - Font swap causes CLS when custom font loads - No `font-display` property specified (defaults to "auto" - invisible for 3s) #### **I. THEME SWITCHING CAUSES LAYOUT SHIFT** **ThemeProvider pattern:** ```jsx useEffect(() => { document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme); }, [theme]); ``` **Problem:** - Initial theme loaded from localStorage in useEffect - First render uses light theme, then switches to saved theme - Box shadows change (light: `0 1px 3px`, dark: `0 2px 8px`) - Card backgrounds change (light: `#f5f5f5`, dark: `#262626`) - Content can shift due to shadow size differences #### **J. NO ASPECT RATIO CONTAINERS** **Example:** ProductCard images ```jsx ``` **Problem:** - No aspect-ratio CSS property - Image dimensions unknown until downloaded - Container grows/shrinks as image loads - Text below image (title, price) shifts up/down --- ### 9. SUMMARY TABLE: CLS RISK ASSESSMENT | Component | Risk Level | Primary Issues | |-----------|-----------|-----------------| | ThemeProvider | HIGH | Late theme loading from localStorage causes flash | | Banner | CRITICAL | Conditional rendering, no height reservation, 192px shift | | LateBanner | CRITICAL | Loads late, no placeholder, 256px height shift | | ProductList | CRITICAL | Text loading state, grid layout shift, no skeletons used | | ProductCard | CRITICAL | Images without dimensions, external image loading | | ProductSkeleton | LOW | Unused (if used, h-48 may not match real images) | | ResultsBar | HIGH | Conditional rendering, padding adds vertical shift | | SidePane | MEDIUM | Sidebar collapse/expand affects main content width | | Overall Layout | CRITICAL | Multiple independent async operations cause cascading shifts | --- ### 10. CUMULATIVE LAYOUT SHIFT (CLS) SCENARIO WALKTHROUGH **User loads page:** 1. **0ms - Initial render:** - Header visible - Body, html tags - Empty placeholders for: Banner, LateBanner, SidePane, ResultsBar, ProductList - Height: ~500px 2. **50ms - useEffects trigger, API calls made (parallel):** - 5 fetch() calls start simultaneously - ProductList shows "Loading products..." text - Layout still ~500px 3. **150ms - SidePane loads (example order):** - Sidebar appears (220px wide) - ProductList shrinks to accommodate - Layout shift: ProductCard grid recalculates width - CLS event: +0.10 4. **200ms - Banner loads:** - Banner content appears - 192px of vertical space taken - All content below shifts down - CLS event: +0.08 5. **250ms - ProductList API resolves:** - "Loading products..." text replaced with 15-product grid - Grid 3 columns × 5 rows - Height jumps from ~30px to ~2000px - All pagination content shifts down - CLS event: +0.25 6. **300ms - Images start loading (parallel):** - Each image initially has no height - As each loads, ProductCard heights change - Content shifts unpredictably - CLS events: +0.05 each × 15 products = +0.75 7. **400ms - ResultsBar loads:** - Pagination UI appears - py-4 padding adds ~24px vertical space - Shifts entire ProductList down - CLS event: +0.02 8. **500ms - LateBanner loads:** - Secondary banner appears - 256px of vertical space - Shifts everything above it up - CLS event: +0.15 9. **1000ms+ - All images loaded:** - Final layout stabilizes - ProductCard heights now fixed by image dimensions - No more shifts **Total CLS Score: ~1.40** (POOR - Google threshold is 0.10) --- ### CONCLUSION This Next.js e-commerce app has **critical CLS issues** caused by: 1. **Conditional rendering** of major page components with no height reservation 2. **Images without dimensions** causing reflow when loaded 3. **Loading state mismatch** (text instead of skeletons) 4. **Multiple independent async operations** creating cascading layout shifts 5. **Sidebar collapse** affecting main content width 6. **Custom font loading** potentially causing text reflow 7. **Theme initialization** causing potential flash of wrong theme 8. **Unused skeleton component** (ProductSkeleton not used) The app would benefit from: - Setting explicit heights/min-heights for all dynamic content - Using skeleton screens (ProductSkeleton is available but unused) - Optimizing images with proper dimensions and aspect ratios - Using Next.js `` component with placeholder - Reserving space for loading states with CSS - Preloading critical fonts - Avoiding sidebar collapse during page load - Synchronizing async operations or showing comprehensive skeleton

content.text:
Here's a summary of all the root causes identified and the fixes applied: ## Root Causes & Fixes ### 1. Banner & LateBanner - Conditional rendering causing massive layout shifts **Problem:** Both components returned `null` while loading, then suddenly appeared (192px and 256px respectively), pushing all content below them down. **Fix** (`Banner.tsx:21-28`, `LateBanner.tsx:21-28`): Always render the container with its full dimensions during loading, using `visibility: hidden` to reserve space. Once data arrives, the content becomes visible without any layout shift. If the API returns no content, the component collapses only after loading confirms there's nothing to show. ### 2. SidePane - Sidebar collapse causing horizontal layout shift **Problem:** Returned `null` while loading, so the main content area initially took full width, then suddenly shrank when the 220px sidebar appeared. **Fix** (`SidePane.tsx:16-56`): Always render the `
` container with its fixed 220px width. Shows animated skeleton placeholders while loading instead of returning null. ### 3. ResultsBar - Conditional rendering causing vertical shift **Problem:** Returned `null` while waiting for both the API response and product data, then suddenly appeared and pushed the product grid down. **Fix** (`ResultsBar.tsx:24-33`): Renders a hidden placeholder with the same dimensions when not yet visible, reserving the vertical space. ### 4. ProductList - Text loading state instead of skeletons **Problem:** Showed a single line of "Loading products..." text, then replaced it with a 15-card grid — a massive vertical shift. The `ProductSkeleton` component existed but was never used. **Fix** (`ProductList.tsx:37-40`): Renders 15 `ProductSkeleton` components in the same 3-column grid during loading, matching the final layout dimensions. ### 5. ProductCard images - No dimensions causing reflow **Problem:** Used bare `` tags with only `className="w-full"` and no height/width attributes. The browser couldn't reserve space for images until they downloaded, causing each card to expand individually. **Fix** (`ProductCard.tsx:17-21`): Added explicit `width={400}` and `height={300}` attributes, `aspect-ratio: 4/3` CSS, `h-auto` class, and `loading="lazy"`. The `ProductSkeleton` was also updated to use the same `aspect-ratio: 4/3` (`ProductSkeleton.tsx:6`) instead of a fixed `h-48` that didn't match real card dimensions. ### 6. Font loading - Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT) **Problem:** The `@font-face` declaration had no `font-display` property, so the browser defaulted to hiding text until the custom font loaded, then reflowed all text when it appeared. **Fix** (`globals.css:12`): Added `font-display: swap` so text renders immediately with a fallback font and swaps smoothly when the custom font loads. ### 7. ThemeProvider - Flash of wrong theme **Problem:** Initial state was always `'light'`, then `useEffect` read from `localStorage` and switched to the saved theme, causing a visible flash where the entire page re-rendered with different colors. **Fix** (`ThemeProvider.tsx:16-49`): Uses `useLayoutEffect` (via isomorphic wrapper) to read the saved theme synchronously before paint. Hides content via `visibility: hidden` until the theme is resolved, preventing any visible flash.
